description: The Embedded view's configuration and intentConfiguration props. Only the Android view reads them; iOS ignores these props and receives the same values through createEmbeddedPaymentElement, which the embedded fixtures pin on both platforms.

unasserted.configuration.returnURL: Android's Embedded element returns through its own redirect activity and does not read returnURL.
unasserted.intentConfiguration.mode.type: The builder consumes mode.type to choose payment or setup. Native code asserts the resulting mode, not this discriminator.
unasserted.intentConfiguration.mode.captureMethod: Automatic is the platform default. This fixture does not observe captureMethod on a built configuration.

parityGaps.configuration.merchantDisplayName: D12: iOS EmbeddedPaymentElementView ignores the configuration and intentConfiguration props and receives the same values through createEmbeddedPaymentElement.
